expectations.text: The response identifies that the Sort/tempdb spill happens because the index order (AssigneeId, CreatedAt, ...) does not match ORDER BY Priority DESC, CreatedAt DESC (range column before sort column)
expectations.evidence: 'The index is in **E-R-S** order... Rows come out ordered by `CreatedAt ASC`, but you need `Priority DESC, CreatedAt DESC`'; spill row explains Sort

expectations.text: The response recommends an index keyed (AssigneeId, Priority DESC, CreatedAt DESC) or equivalent ESR order
expectations.evidence: `ON dbo.Tickets (AssigneeId ASC, Priority DESC, CreatedAt DESC)` with ESR mapping

expectations.text: The response recommends INCLUDE (Subject) (or otherwise making the index covering) to remove the Key Lookup
expectations.evidence: Explicitly declines covering: 'Why I'm not adding `INCLUDE (Subject)` yet: with an ordered index, the Key Lookup runs only for the ~20 rows'. Reasoned trade-off, but it does not recommend INCLUDE/covering to remove the Key Lookup

expectations.text: The response points out the estimated 1,850 vs actual 41,233 rows gap and links it to statistics and/or parameter sniffing
expectations.evidence: 'Estimated 1,850 vs actual 41,233 | This is a cardinality problem: parameter sniffing...' plus stats freshness check via sys.dm_db_stats_properties

expectations.text: The response estimates or reasons about how many rows the new index will read for TOP 20 given ~10% of the agent's tickets match @Since
expectations.evidence: Good-plan expectation 'about 20 for option 1 in the good case, ≤ 80 for option 2', and the weakness: if top priority has <20 recent tickets 'the scan keeps reading that priority's *old* tickets'

expectations.text: The response says what to do with the existing IX_Tickets_Assignee_Created (replace/drop after verification, or DROP_EXISTING)
expectations.evidence: 'Then deal with the old index (don't drop it blindly)': check dm_db_index_usage_stats, then `ALTER INDEX IX_Tickets_Assignee_Created ... DISABLE` before dropping

expectations.text: The response mentions building online (ONLINE = ON) and/or its edition requirement
expectations.evidence: `WITH (ONLINE = ON, SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ON); -- ONLINE needs Enterprise`

expectations.evidence: Verify section with `SET STATISTICS IO, TIME ON`, actual plan, before/after table with 'Logical reads 131,904 | (fill in)' and 'Send me the new plan and these numbers'
